reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, isDailyWeekendSkip, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, dayFromDate and parseDate rather than re-deriving any of them.

duplication.why: The occurrence-to-day pipeline (daily-weekend filter, conditional getDateWithSkippedWeekend map, dayFromDate) is copied from getUpcomingDates rather than extracted into a shared step both handlers use.

placement.why: A new server handler in schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates, registered in SchedulesHandlers and app.method like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Small, readable and commented (the two-day window margin), though a change to weekend handling must now be made in two near-identical pipelines.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the existing shared weekend helpers and RSchedule wrapper.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied filter/map chain from getUpcomingDates is recognisably the same, with only the skipDailyWeekends local inlined as isDailyWeekendSkip(config).
